title: Naturality of the normalized scalar-extension section
statement: Let J be a small site with coefficient tower B and a coefficient map phi:R->systemRing(J,B). Fix normalized ScalarData A and an R-module sheaf M on the sequence site. For n<=m, a section x of M(m,U), and evaluated sections v at m and w at n identified by HEq with the scalar-extension units of x and its horizontal restriction, the evaluated transition of A.model.E(M) sends v to a section HEq to w. This uses no roots, Chern datum, geometric pullback, or finite line comparison.

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension of the roots tower; horizontal transition calculation of lem-sfb-tower-class-line-pullback-existence

proof.text: The defining unit_section equation and cancellation of the canonical object comparison identify scalarExtensionSection with the ordinary adjunction unit. The unit is a module-sheaf morphism; apply its presheaf naturality to the horizontal sequence-site arrow and x. The defining transition equation identifies the evaluated map with that presheaf restriction. Scalar restriction changes no underlying sections or restriction maps.

proof_origin.place: classes (2), scalar extension and horizontal naturality of the roots tower
